args.title: Fix issue 4406 in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The file src/ingest/parser.ts contains the parseStatement function which parses CSV lines and asserts the shape of each row against the header. The function trims trailing empty lines, but a final newline leaves an empty string that is popped once. However, if the file ends with multiple blank lines or the last line is empty, it still processes that line causing an assertion failure 'Malformed row' from assertShape when column count mismatches. The fix needed is to better handle trailing empty lines before parsing rows to avoid malformed row errors on trailing empty lines.
